description: This Java class serves as a REST endpoint in a Spring application, handling HTTP GET requests at '/app/info' to return application info as a resource. It utilizes services to fetch data, maps domain models to resources, and manages exceptions within the endpoint.

classes.name: AppInfoRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller that provides an endpoint to retrieve application information
